plan.title: Order Activity records answered counter offer

steps.note: Create a test event for the counter-offer flow.
Use an RFQ stage because counter offers apply to vendor pricing bids.
Every created event requires a title.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product so the vendor can submit a quote.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a usable bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor to receive and answer the counter offer.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event is available on its project page.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the counter offer can be initiated.
Send the buyer's counter offer against the vendor's bid.
Assert that the counter offer was initiated in the buyer grid.
Have the vendor answer the counter offer by accepting it.
Return to the buyer portal before inspecting buyer-side Order Activity.
Confirm the buyer view records the vendor's acceptance.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and choose Order Activity.
Check that the activity drawer contains a counter-offer-related entry.
Check that the activity text reflects the counter offer was answered.
